findings.description: Critical: validate-feature Step 11's Choices-row snippet resolves the ledger via `CHOICES_JSON="$OPENSPEC_PATH/changes/$CHANGE_ID/choices.json"` and `needs_user.py --repo-root "$PROJECT_ROOT"`. After Step 1's `eval "$(worktree.py detect)"`, a managed worktree sets `OPENSPEC_PATH`/`PROJECT_ROOT` to the shared main checkout, not the feature worktree. `iterate-on-implementation` Step 11.5 commits the ledger under the worktree-relative `openspec/changes/$CHANGE_ID/` on the feature branch, so the validation gate's presence check misses it and always renders `○ Choices: no ledger`, and the reader (also pointed at main) prints nothing. Reproduced: relative worktree ledger FOUND; `$OPENSPEC_PATH/.../choices.json` MISSING; `--repo-root "$PROJECT_ROOT"` silent while `--repo-root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` lists the needs-user line. This breaks skill-workflow.9/11 on the mandated local worktree path (non-ephemeral). cleanup-feature Step 5.5 correctly uses relative `openspec/changes/...` and default `--repo-root .`.
findings.resolution: Root the Choices presence check and reader at the checkout under validation, matching Step 2's `CHANGE_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/openspec/changes/$CHANGE_ID"` or cleanup-feature's relative `openspec/changes/$CHANGE_ID/choices.json` with `--repo-root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` (or omit `--repo-root` when cwd is already that toplevel). Do not use detect's main-repo `OPENSPEC_PATH`/`MAIN_REPO` for branch-scoped ledger files.

findings.description: Nit: `test_workflow_hooks.py` pins skill-relative `needs_user.py` invocation and the `○`/`✓` wordings, but never asserts that the ledger path / `--repo-root` target the current feature checkout. `test_no_ledger_path_survives_set_u` even injects `OPENSPEC_PATH="openspec"`, which hides the worktree failure mode where detect sets `OPENSPEC_PATH` to the absolute main-repo openspec. Finding 1's regression therefore keeps the suite green while skill-workflow.9/11 fail in real worktree runs.
findings.resolution: Assert the Choices fence does not use `$OPENSPEC_PATH`/`$PROJECT_ROOT`/`$MAIN_REPO` for the ledger, and add an executable case that sets worktree-like `OPENSPEC_PATH=$MAIN/openspec` + `PROJECT_ROOT=$MAIN` while the ledger exists only under the cwd worktree openspec, expecting the ⚠/needs-user path (or at least not `○ Choices: no ledger`).
